cases.disposition_reason: Compare levels reaches no color after 256 colors and 16 colors. The 80 by 24 frame stays on no color, and closing compare restores the states grid with the option defaults unchanged.
cases.action_sequence: Turn Compare levels on, scroll the bands, narrow the terminal, then turn Compare levels off.
cases.expected_results: Colour bands for the supported levels are visible, and the page state is unchanged after return.
cases.forbidden_effects: Leaving Compare levels changes the selected page or an option value.

cases.disposition_reason: A cancelled analytics test leaves the sample list unchanged. Saving Warehouse, cancelling a rename to Temporary, then duplicating and deleting Warehouse copy leaves Warehouse in the list. The filter narrows the list to Staging, and Production's host returns. The footer reads Deleted Warehouse copy.
cases.action_sequence: Create, edit, test, save, cancel, duplicate, and delete a connection. Filter, and show empty, loading, and failure.
cases.expected_results: Reopen shows the saved fields. Cancel keeps the previous record. Delete removes only the chosen connection.
cases.forbidden_effects: A failed test marks the connection saved when it was not.
